title: USDA FIA TREE input projection used by canonical preprocessing (schema only)
description: The canonical script reads only this six-column projection from state TREE tables. The raw tables are external and are not included in the public candidate.

x-openrec-eo.public_action: Never ship source-derived TREE rows. A synthetic fixture, if later added, must be labelled SYNTHETIC_NON_SCIENTIFIC_FIXTURE.

PLT_CN.description: FIA plot/measurement control number used to join selected measurements.

STATUSCD.description: Tree status code; the frozen protocol retains live trees (STATUSCD == 1).

DIA.description: Tree diameter in inches; the frozen threshold is DIA >= 5.0.

DRYBIO_AG.description: Above-ground dry biomass source field; may be missing.

HT.description: Tree height source field; may be missing.
